If I rank y higher than w, I might increase my chance of getting y, but then I risk losing value by getting y instead of w if I could have gotten w. Since my priority at w is also 1, it's likely I'll get w if I rank it high enough.

Given that others prefer y > x > w > z, ranking w first is relatively safe. Ranking y second is also safe since it's my second choice and I have high priority there. I should keep x and z in my true preference order.

Therefore, submitting my true preference order seems optimal.
